title: Salesforce Consultant / Developer
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Consultant or Developer (minimum 8-10 years of experience) to join our expanding AMS support and Project Delivery team for a leading US-based client. The role requires strong Salesforce expertise in consulting and/or development, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality support and enhancements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day support, maintenance, and enhancement of the client's Salesforce environment.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
  • Design, configure, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.).
  • Manage and maintain integrations with other systems.
  • Collaborate with client teams and internal technical resources.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain system documentation and support user training efforts.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Consultant or Developer.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant, etc.) highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Flows.
  • Experience with integration tools and APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote setting.


Extensive expertise in some of the following areas:

  • B2B and e-Commerce solutions
  • Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Marketing Cloud
  • Experience Cloud (Community Cloud)
  • Einstein and AI-driven analytics
  • MuleSoft Integration Suite and Integration Designer Platform (IDP)


Nice to have Qualifications:

  • Experience with ChatGPT 4.0 prompt engineering or similar AI tools, particularly document ingestion use cases, is a significant advantage.

title: Sourcer Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job Title: Data Architect

Duration: 6months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

What You’ll Do

Design & Strategy: Develop and maintain the overall data architecture aligned with organizational strategy.

Blueprint Creation: Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support data storage, processing, and consumption needs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.

Governance & Security: Define and enforce data governance, data quality, and security standards across all data systems.

Technology Selection: Evaluate and select cloud platforms, storage solutions, and data processing tools appropriate for enterprise needs.

Implementation Leadership: Oversee the delivery of data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, and APIs.

Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability across all data systems.


Key Skills

  • Modern Data Modelling: Expertise with dbt modelling approaches and Snowflake‑optimized schemas (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).
  • Snowflake Architecture: Strong knowledge of virtual warehouses, scaling, clustering, and storage optimization.
  • Airflow Orchestration: Ability to design and manage complex Airflow DAGs.
  • Advanced SQL & Python: Expertise in transforming, processing, and orchestrating data.
  • AWS Infrastructure: Hands‑on experience with S3, IAM, and Private Link for secure and efficient data access.
  • ELT Strategy: Skilled in building ELT pipelines using tools like Fivetran and dbt.


Preferred Skills

  • Active Metadata & Governance (Atlan)
  • BI Semantic Layering
  • Data Mesh & Data Contracts
  • FinOps & Cost Governance
  • CI/CD for Data Pipelines

title: Auxiliar de produção de Equipamentos Eletrônicos
description:
Buscamos AUXILIAR DE PRODUÇÃO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS na Montagem de produtos eletrônicos .

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 32 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Auxiliar de Produção ” desempenha um papel fundamental na linha de produção. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Realizar atividades operacionais tais como recebimento de materiais e produtos para produção
  • Organização, limpeza e zelo pelos materiais e recursos necessários ao trabalho
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Ensino médio em andamento
  • Coordenação motora
  • Atenção concentrada
  • Senso de segurança

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • Ensino médio completo
  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência em produção e montagem de produtos

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo:                    CLT
  • Formato:                  Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada:                   Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho:    Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Position Summary: Illumina is seeking a highly motivated and team-oriented Senior ServiceNow developer (Contractor) to drive solutions within our IDS ServiceNow team. This team primarily manages the ServiceNow platform supporting workflows, integrations, and automation for various internal business teams such as IT, HR, Facilities, Custom Applications and Finance. This position will be responsible for implementing, enhancing and maintaining across multiple ServiceNow modules and developing integrations on those modules.

Responsibilities:

· Implement and enhance ServiceNow platform and modules per business requirements.

· Complete development, configuration and workflow administration to support business processes in the platform.

· Provide day to day operational support and maintenance including planned maintenance outages.

· Collect, consolidate and analyze service metrics to facilitate decision making related to service improvements.

· Conduct unit testing and install new modules, releases and version upgrades.

· Actively manages the life-cycle of the platform.

· Monitor and fine tune application to achieve optimum performance levels.


Requirements:

· At least 4 years minimum working as a ServiceNow developer

· Experience in various ServiceNow Modules with preferred experience in the ServiceNow FSM and Developing Custom applications in ServiceNow.

· Expertise in ServiceNow scripting including JavaScript, Angular JS, Bootstrap and Jelly Script

· Expertise in Web technologies (Web Services, XML, HTML, CSS, HTTP, etc)

· Experience using Integration Hub and Flow Designer.

· Preferred ServiceNow Certifications in CSA, CAD or CIS in FSM

· Strong analytical, problem solving, organizational and planning skills.

***This role can pay around $5,300 USD monthly

title: Consultor Oracle B2C Service (RightNow)
description:
Estamos buscando un Consultor Oracle B2C Service (RightNow)

Perfil con experiencia sólida en implementación, soporte y personalización dentro del ecosistema Oracle CX.


Requisitos principales:

  • +3 años trabajando con Oracle B2C Service (RightNow) .
  • Conocimientos avanzados en PHP, JavaScript, HTML y CSS .
  • Manejo de RightNow APIs : Connect Web Services, REST API y ROQL.
  • Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas (debugging, troubleshooting, performance tuning).
  • Experiencia en personalización: portal widgets, extensiones, scripts PHP .
  • Experiencia con Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) .


Responsabilidades:

  • Resolver incidentes productivos según SLAs.
  • Desarrollo y mejora de extensiones en RightNow BUI .
  • Implementación de reglas de negocio, workflows y automatizaciones.
  • Integración con sistemas externos (CRM, ERP, telefonía, pagos) vía REST/SOAP.
  • Customización del Customer Portal con foco en UI/UX.
  • Optimización de performance y ajustes de escalabilidad.
  • Procesos ETL, migraciones y aseguramiento de integridad de datos.
  • Evaluación de upgrades trimestrales y ejecución de pruebas de regresión.


Modalidad: Remoto

Idiomas: Inglés y Portugués (conversacional)

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .

Location: Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelors (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: UX Researcher (Mid-Level)
description:
We are looking for a curious, empathetic, and data-driven UX Researcher to join our team at Edward Martin. With at least 3 years of experience, you will be the bridge between our users and our product strategy. You will lead end-to-step research initiatives—from defining the problem to delivering actionable insights that influence design and engineering.

The ideal candidate is a master of qualitative methods, particularly In-Depth Interviews (IDIs) , and has a proven track record of synthesizing complex data into Personas and Critical User Journeys (CUJs) .


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Research: Lead the planning, recruitment, execution, and analysis of qualitative research studies.
  • Qualitative Mastery: Conduct high-impact IDIs to uncover deep-seated user needs, pain points, and motivations.
  • Strategic Artifacts: Translate raw data into foundational design tools, including robust User Personas and detailed Critical User Journeys (CUJs) that map the user’s path across touchpoints.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product Designers and Product Managers to identify research gaps and ensure findings are integrated into the product roadmap.
  • Insight Evangelism: Present findings through compelling storytelling to stakeholders, moving beyond \"what happened\" to \"why it matters\" and \"what we should do next.\"
  • Research tool: Familiar with research tools such as UserTesting, Dscout, Qualtrics, Google Drive, etc.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a UX Researcher or Product Researcher.
  • Expertise in qualitative methodologies , specifically moderating interviews and conducting thematic analysis.
  • Proven ability to map Critical User Journeys that highlight friction points and opportunities.
  • Experience building and maintaining User Personas that are used by cross-functional teams to make decisions.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating how your research directly impacted a product's direction.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication skills for both research and share-out purposes.


Preferred \"Plus\" Skills

  • Quantitative Proficiency: Experience designing, launching, and analyzing quantitative surveys to validate qualitative findings or measure user sentiment at scale.


Who You Are

  • You are a critical thinker who doesn't just take requests but asks \"What is the core question we are trying to answer?\"
  • You are an excellent communicator who can tailor your delivery to both designers and executives.
  • You are organized and capable of managing multiple research workstreams simultaneously.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net + IA Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET , com experiência sólida em arquitetura de software e integração com Inteligência Artificial , para atuar na construção de soluções escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a dados.

Se você gosta de backend bem feito, código limpo e quer trabalhar aplicando IA de forma prática e responsável , essa vaga é para você.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Desenvolvimento Backend (.NET)

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando .NET / .NET Core (.NET 6+) .
  • Criar, evoluir e manter APIs REST e/ou GraphQL , serviços e integrações.
  • Aplicar boas práticas como Clean Code, SOLID, DDD e arquitetura em camadas .

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Python Sênior

Atuação: 100% home office

Projeto: Prazo indeterminado


Buscamos por um Desenvolvedor Python Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico, com foco em desenvolvimento backend, processamento de dados e arquitetura de microsserviços, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia, qualidade de código e observabilidade.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Python

• Construir APIs utilizando Flask e FastAPI

• Atuar com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

• Processar e manipular dados utilizando Pandas e Polars

• Trabalhar com mensageria como Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ ou Kafka

• Atuar com bancos de dados relacionais como SQL Server

• Contribuir com boas práticas de código, padrões de arquitetura e testes

• Utilizar ferramentas de observabilidade e qualidade como Sonar e Datadog

• Colaborar com o time técnico na evolução das soluções e arquitetura


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida com Python para desenvolvimento backend

• Vivência com Flask e ou FastAPI

• Experiência com Pandas e Polars

• Conhecimento em Programação Orientada a Objetos

• Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura e padrões de código

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços

• Vivência com mensageria

• Experiência com banco de dados relacional

• Atuação em ambientes cloud Azure ou similar

• Experiência com Docker

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes

• Experiência com testes unitários

• Vivência com GitFlow


Se você gosta de desafios, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade.

title: Arquiteto de soluções Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções Azure


Descrição:


  • Experiência mandatória com Projeto com IA utilizando Copilot e Microsoft Foundry
  • Design e Implantação de Arquitetura;
  • Especialista em .NET Framework/.NET Core;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis utilizando serviços de nuvem como Azure (App Service, API Management, tecnologias serverless, orquestração de containers como Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, frameworks de microsserviços, SDKs e etc);
  • Habilidade em apresentações técnicas e foco no cliente, confortável em diferentes públicos;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas em implantação de aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes locais e na nuvem;
  • Experiência em DevOps (Azure DevOps Services, Azure DevOps Server);
  • Experiência técnica em larga escala com infraestruturas em nuvem e híbridas, design de arquitetura, migrações e gestão de tecnologia;
  • Vivência e entendimento de portfólios de aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, incluindo migração de workloads locais para a nuvem;
  • Experiência técnica em larga escala com hospedagem de aplicações nativas em nuvem, design, desenvolvimento, implantação e refatoração/migração de aplicações;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de servidores web, design de aplicações em nuvem, arquitetura de software e práticas como Agile, SCRUM e DevOps;
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento de software como DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, Spinnaker, Azure DevOps, etc);
  • Certificações AZ-204, AZ-400;


Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens exporaticas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Arquiteto de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Dados com experiência em Microsoft Azure e Databricks , para liderar iniciativas de governança e arquitetura de dados em projetos estratégicos. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem visão consultiva e gosta de ambientes dinâmicos e colaborativos, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes usando Microsoft Azure (Synapse, Fabric, Data Factory, Purview, AD) e Databricks .
  • Definir e implementar pipelines ETL/ELT (Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, SQL) com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e custo.
  • Criar e operacionalizar camada de governança: catálogo de dados, lineage, políticas de acesso (RLS , RBAC ), classificação de sensibilidade e masking.
  • Estabelecer práticas de data quality , contratos de dados e SLAs de ingestão/transformação.
  • Garantir aderência a LGPD/GDPR e melhores práticas de segurança (encryption, key management).
  • Documentar arquiteturas, padrões e runbooks; defender decisões técnicas em comitês de arquitetura.
  • Mentorar engenheiros e analistas, promovendo boas práticas, code reviews e automação (CI/CD para infra e pipelines).
  • Liderar PoCs e provas de valor, estimar esforços e mapear custos (cloud spend / FinOps mindset).
  • Colaborar com Product Owners para alinhar roadmap técnico com objetivos de negócio e time-to-market.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, implementar e manter APIs RESTful de alta performance, seguras e escaláveis;
  • Realizar integrações entre sistemas Java, bancos Oracle e plataformas ERP;
  • Participar da implantação de soluções de pagamento eletrônico, incluindo PIX;
  • Analisar, adaptar, documentar e realizar a manutenção de funcionalidades legadas desenvolvidas em Visual Basic, garantindo a integração e a evolução contínua dessas aplicações no ambiente corporativo.
  • Automatizar testes unitários e de integração, assegurando qualidade e cobertura de código;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas, fluxos de integração e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança, privacidade de dados e políticas internas;
  • Contribuir para o versionamento, revisão de código e melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de implantação em produção, atuando na resolução ágil de incidentes;
  • Engajar-se em squads ágeis, contribuindo para a evolução dos produtos e cultura DevOps.



Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com Java, Spring Boot e padrões JEE;
  • Conhecimento em Oracle Database e PL/SQL;
  • Prática em desenvolvimento, exposição e consumo de APIs REST via gateways/barramentos;
  • Experiência com servidores de aplicação (JBoss, WebLogic, ou equivalentes);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento, Git, GitHub, GitLab) e práticas de CI e CD;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento, manutenção e documentação de aplicações em Visual Basic (VB6/VBA) e tecnologias associadas;
  • Vivência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de documentação técnica;
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe, comunicação clara e postura colaborativa.



E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border ), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat ) e stablecoins , bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins .
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins , fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.

title: Engineer Manager
description:
Remoto | Grupo SBF | Ecossistema do Esporte


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engineering Manager para liderar nossas equipes de engenharia com foco em excelência técnica, impacto nos negócios e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Essa é uma posição estratégica de liderança, com responsabilidade direta sobre entregas, pessoas e processos.

Se você tem paixão por formar times de alta performance, toma decisões baseadas em dados e sabe equilibrar visão técnica e foco em pessoas, essa vaga pode ser sua próxima jornada!


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança à frente de mais de um contexto;
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Histórico de entregas com impacto real (eficiência, performance, redução de custo ou aumento de satisfação);
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e metodologias ágeis ;
  • Familiaridade com métricas de times de engenharia (DORA Metrics ou similares);
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos e em escala ;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e empática ;
  • Capacidade de liderar e desenvolver times diversos , promovendo um ambiente seguro , colaborativo e de crescimento ;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em resolver problemas complexos com inovação e senso de urgência.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar times de engenharia, garantindo entregas estratégicas com qualidade e alinhamento aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Atuar próximo a Produto, Design, Segurança e Infraestrutura para garantir sinergia e integração nas entregas;
  • Ser responsável por desenvolvimento de pessoas, feedbacks, mentoring e formação de cultura;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas relevantes, com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, riscos e priorizações, com capacidade de adaptação e liderança em momentos de crise;
  • Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de experimentação e aprendizagem contínua.


✨ Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior em e-commerce ou ambientes de larga escala;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação organizacional ou melhoria contínua;
  • Publicações técnicas, participação em comunidades, eventos ou contribuições open source;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001) e atuação com Security Champions.


—

Se interessou?

title: Coordenador de Ciência de Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais da equipe de Data Science;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de Data Science alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais;
  • Participar ativamente nos processos de recrutamento, desenvolvimento de talentos e desligamento de profissionais;
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, criando um ambiente propício para aprendizado contínuo e aprimoramento de habilidades;
  • Interagir de forma colaborativa com líderes de outras áreas para compreender suas necessidades analíticas;
  • Participar ativamente na gestão de orçamentos e recursos;
  • Relatar os resultados para a gerência e propor melhorias;
  • Tomar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao direcionamento de projetos de Data Science.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Necessário graduação completa;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado desejável em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas de IA aplicada, incluindo IA Generativa, modelos preditivos e agents.
  • Necessário experiência em liderança, desenvolvimento de talentos e orçamento;
  • Necessário experiência em gestão de projetos de dados;
  • Necessário experiência em técnicas, linguagens e ferramentas de aprendizado de máquina e Data Science, como Python, R, frameworks de IA e Machine Learning, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, TensorFlow, XGBoost, LightGBM, Kubeflow, entre outros;
  • Necessário experiência em aplicação de métodos estatísticos e análise preditiva;
  • Necessário experiência em desenvolvimento de pipelines para análise e interpretação de dados, aplicação e produção de algoritmos de IA tradicional, IA generativa e Agentes de IA.
  • Desejável ter atuado utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Project);
  • Desejável experiência em Cloud providers;
  • Desejável experiência em práticas de governança de dados e conformidade com regulamentações de privacidade, como GDPR.
  • Desejável experiência em medidas de segurança de dados para proteger a integridade e a confidencialidade das informações.
  • Desejável domínio do Pacote Office e inglês intermediário..


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho: 100%Home Office

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: 5x2

Horário de Trabalho: segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

title: Arquiteto(a) em Soluções SAP SuccessFactors BTP
description:
• Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida das soluções propostas, desde o desenho e desenvolvimento até o acompanhamento da entrega.
  • Estimar custos e esforços para novas soluções e projetos complexos de implantação.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors e domínio técnico de soluções BTP/SCPI (Integration Suite).
  • Desenvolver extensões no SAP BTP (CAP) utilizando Node.js aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar a estratégia e execução de desenvolvimentos, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas (Clean Core, Microserviços, arquitetura orientada a APIs).
  • Implementar integrações standard do SAP SuccessFactors (BIB, Infoporter, Point-to-Point, MDI, IDoc, ALE).
  • Construir integrações complexas com SAP Integration Suite, ABAP, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway, OAuth 2.0, SAML e Webservices SOAP.
  • Desenvolver APIs customizadas para SAP ECP e S/4HANA, garantindo segurança e performance.
  • Garantir segurança, escalabilidade e governança das integrações, incluindo monitoramento e troubleshooting.
  • Definir padrões técnicos para extensões e integrações, promovendo arquitetura sustentável e alinhada às estratégias corporativas.


Requisitos :

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência como Arquiteto SAP SuccessFactors em projetos de implementação.
  • Experiência na implementação de integrações standard (BIB, Point-to-Point, Infoporter, MDI, ALE, IDoc).
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors, SAP Integration Suite, ABAP HCM, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway e SAP BTP.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento no SAP BTP (CAP) com Node.js.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e troubleshooting (SAP Cloud Integration Monitor).
  • Certificações SAP BTP, SuccessFactors ou TOGAF serão consideradas diferenciais.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP ALM, SAP Fiori e práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, Cloud Foundry).
  • Familiaridade com LGPD/GDPR e segurança de dados.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno/Sênior - ID 123360
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Engenharia de Dados: Data Ingestion, Data Stream, PRocessamento Paralelo, Processamento Massivo. Arquitetura de Dados: ETL vs ELT, Modelagem tradicional, Dimensional e Hibrido, Estruturado / Não Estruturado, Camada de Dados Brutos (SOR), Camada de Dados Harmonizados (SOT), Camada de Dados Especializados (SPEC), Data Analytics, Data Viz, Data Storytelling. Experiencia com processamento distribuído e de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência em Pipelines CI/CD (codepipeline / githubactions); Conhecimento nos serviços primários da AWS (Storage Gateway, Direct Connect, DMS, Lambda, Glue, RDS, API Gateway)


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

  • Nosso site:

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

title: IT Technical Customer Support - English Advanced - 3 years of experience
description:
What a Day In The Life Looks Like


  • Utilize active listening, empathy, and other emotional intelligent skills to properly handle customer interactions.
  • Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software.
  • Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to ERP Vendor, Honeywell/Vocollect, RF Hardware Provider, Seagull Scientific, Bartender, Georgia Softworks, or other third parties.
  • Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments.
  • Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of cloud solutions.
  • SQL performance monitoring / index and query tuning.
  • Meet or exceed defined customer service satisfaction scores and meet SLAs for initial response and issue resolution.
  • Maintain clear, concise communication with customers and internal teams. Accurately document all relevant information in the ticketing system.
  • Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams, external partners, and vendors. Proactively escalate tickets when necessary to ensure timely resolution.
  • API endpoints and confirm.


What You Bring To The Team


  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of technical customer support experience.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Google, etc.).
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and self-manage.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory


You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With


  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Analista de Dados sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos, garantindo análises precisas, geração de insights e apoio à tomada de decisão através de dados.

Será responsável por estruturar bases, desenvolver dashboards e implementar práticas que assegurem a qualidade e a governança das informações.


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:

  • SQL Server: Domínio em banco de dados relacional.
  • QuickSight ou Power BI: Habilidade em construir dashboards.
  • Integration Services (SSIS): Conhecimento em ETL com foco em performance.
  • Python: Automações, análises avançadas e tratamento de dados.
  • Imprescindível experiência: AWS
  • Foco em dados e BI.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios, dashboards e indicadores de performance.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para entender as necessidades de negócio.
  • Participar da evolução contínua da arquitetura de dados da empresa.


Contratação CLT

Formato: Home Office

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Engineer AWS Expert who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proven experience with AWS (API Gateway, Lambda/Fargate, S3, Glue, CloudWatch). Strong knowledge of PySpark (partitioning, joins, optimization). Experience with Glue Data Catalog and querying via Athena. Experience with integration and manipulation of data in REST APIs. Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation). Good practices in version control (Git) and CI/CD.


Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Use of Data Quality tools (Great Expectations, Soda).

Knowledge of Step Functions, EventBridge, or Kinesis.

Best practices for API security (Cognito, WAF, IAM Policies).

Soft Skills:

Good communication and teamwork.

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Ability to handle agile environments and rapid changes.


Design, develop, and maintain APIs using AWS API Gateway.

Implement integrations with Lambda or Fargate for data ingestion.

Develop processing pipelines in PySpark (AWS Glue or EMR).

Manage data in S3 and Glue Data Catalog.

Ensure data quality and integrity (data quality checks).

Optimize pipeline costs and performance.

Create and maintain technical documentation and development standards.

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

Diferenciais

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Portuguese speaking Data Engineer to work across Microsoft Azure solutions in delivering proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in remotely in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
  • Architect and optimize Data Lake storage solutions for structured and unstructured data.
  • Leverage Azure Databricks for big data processing, analytics, and machine learning workflows.
  • Integrate Azure Machine Learning models into data pipelines and business applications.
  • Design and maintain Azure SQL databases, ensuring performance, scalability, and security.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Professional English written and oral communication
  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or similar role in a cloud-first environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Azure Foundry, Data Factory, Data Lake, Databricks, and Azure SQL.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and its integration into enterprise data platforms.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and deployment in Azure ML.
  • Expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.


If you are interested in working with premier enterprise businesses across The Americas, then please apply!


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying
